pages.text: The Soul Crucible is you mid-game method of obtaining good amount of $(l:shadowthings:souls)souls$() for crafting and some smelting. $(br)The block smelts items for souls. Just like a normal coal generator you find in many mods.
It can smelt:$(li)Rotten Flesh$(li)Bone$(li)Spider Eye$(li)Soul Sand$(br)The lower in the list the more souls it produces. It can also be $(l:shadowthings:soul_upgrades)upgraded.$()
